claim: Reserved source-fidelity assessment of qualified integration, readable answer and complete export. Not biological truth, independent prediction, pair-disjoint generalization or organizer scoring.
selection: Keep the original four reserved files, split and release; never replace, re-rank or choose by their proteins, eligibility, outcomes or favorable coverage.

rules.source_eligibility: Unchanged original protocol: both exact unambiguous UniProtKB source primary identifiers, explicitly only human taxa9606 and proteinMI0326; traceable source/evidence/publication incl selectedPMID. Isoforms, constructs, literal missing states and all ineligible rows retained.
rules.object_reduction: Eligible source identity remains in denominator even if official object loses context or downstream resolution, attachment, answer or export fails; such incompleteness is a miss, not a new eligibility exclusion.
rules.grouping: Retain every original physical row and n-ary/XML interaction identity. Expanded rows may share one source experiment/object; never count pair views, reciprocal assays, figures or experiment accessions as independent biological replications.
rules.source_and_model_defaults: Preserve negative literaltrue/false/- and default provenance. XML model defaults cannot prove explicit markup. Absent expansion means annotation notsupplied, never proof of binary origin/direct binding.
rules.reference_ambiguity: Non-bijective MITAB/XML mapping is not automatically an error: account for source-annotated n-ary expansion. Unexplained identity/participant mismatch or ambiguous reference projection stops scoring; do not silently collapse/repair.
rules.provenance_gate: Audit exact PMID/DOI/evidence identities and explicit shared primary/subsidiary dataset annotations against a declared consumed inventory before scoring. Exclude known consumed-linked connectedstudycomponents without replacement. Generic see-also, method citation, shared pair/protein or ownIMEx registration alone cannot establish shared or independent data.
rules.unresolved_provenance: Keep incomplete/ambiguous lineage visible. Missing annotations cannot certify independence. Ambiguous potentially shared dataset interpretation requires adjudication before scoring; if retained with no explicit shared link, label study independence unverified.
rules.exclusion_accounting: Preserve source-eligible counts before study-level provenance exclusions, excludedstudycomponents/counts/reasons and finalscoreeligible counts separately. Pair/participant flags never silently alter source eligibility.
rules.overlap_report: Report exact unordered source-accession pair, oriented participant identities and evidence/experiment/study overlap against development and declared consumed references. Retain isoforms. Shared protein/pair flags describe exposure; a source-fidelity test is not a pair-disjoint prediction test.
rules.no_graph_action: No scientific acceptance, graph deletion or calibrated confidence follows from source-fidelity scores.

provenance_semantics.qualification: Shared datasets require the primary/subsidiary experiment comment context. see-also also appears for errata/DOI aliases. uniprot-dr-export:No or imex-primary alone is not a study-reuse classifier.
provenance_semantics.article_status: Record known correction/retraction/republication metadata separately. Existing ESummary check is not article-level clearance; do not infer absence of alerts.

metrics.units: Original source evidence-row locator; also report original evidence/experiment groups and perpublication macro summaries.
metrics.coverage: Complete answer/export rows / all final-assessment eligible rows after explicit study-level provenance exclusions; show originalsourceeligible denominator and removedstudycomponents separately.
metrics.strict_fidelity: Rows with every applicable originalfieldgroup and locator preserved / sameeligible denominator. Incomplete answers, abstention and downstreamfailed rows countasmisses.
metrics.strata: All original negative/expansion/type/method/missing-context strata with counts; empty strata unevaluated.
metrics.uncertainty: Descriptive finite-panel microcounts and perpublication macro results. No independence-assuming pair bootstrap or broadaccuracy estimate.

full_flow_commitments_required_before_ac: Separate final orchestration and reference loader leave all original development guards untouched; no four-row or dev-only count assumption.
Freeze actual official MITAB/XML reader/runtime/controls, rawref loader, importer, answer/export evaluator and exact source URLs/receipts before any reserved body read/hash/parse.
Test invented lineage/sharedstudy, repeatedpair, n-ary, malformed/default, unresolvedidentity, missingoutput and emptystrata cases plus a consumeddevelopment replay before finalfreeze.
Freeze complete consumed-reference inventory or explicitly bound incompleteness, exact overlap semantics and article-status check scope.

Freeze exact question template, deterministic focus/order, profile/caps/batching/identityresolution/failure policy and any Pharosretrieval state before finalidentitiesvisible. No selection of successfullyresolvedrows.
Write immutable pre-access receipt with allcode/input/runtimehashes; one controlled fixed execution preserves failures and exposure. No new model/agentarm without separatelyfrozen contract.

remaining_checks: Implement and independently verify a thin separate final full-flow orchestrator using existing pure helpers; current entrypoints intentionally support development only.
Complete its synthetic cases and consumeddevelopment replay, preserving row/experiment multiplicity and source-eligible denominators.
Bind the consumed inventory and declared scope of lineage/article-status checks.
Seal one immutable execution receipt before auditing reserved provenance/overlap and scoring.

biological_improvement_boundary: Design now in parallel. One published task-compatible intervention may be tried in a predeclared matched retrospective/development comparison on already-consumed outcomes, without labeling them unseen or independently confirmatory. Keep scored labels/derivatives outside predictor inputs; outcomes used for fitting yield training performance. Compare Pharos, same-information plain addition and Steward qualification where applicable, with matched learner/candidates/seeds/budget. Fresh suitably separated evidence is needed for confirmatory external generalization or source-novelty claims. The current IntAct reserved panel only tests source fidelity. No verified compatible intervention is ready yet; this is distinct from unknown Pharos lineage.
